lessons.title: Adopting a Dog
lessons.context: A short story about a family deciding to adopt a rescue dog.

paragraphs.tr: Aile uzun süredir bir köpek sahiplenmeyi konuşuyordu.
paragraphs.en: The family had been discussing adopting a dog for a long time.

paragraphs.tr: Sonunda yerel bir barınağı ziyaret etmeye karar verdiler.
paragraphs.en: In the end, they decided to visit a local shelter.

paragraphs.tr: Orada onlara koşarak gelen küçük ve sevimli bir köpekle tanıştılar.
paragraphs.en: There they met a small, adorable dog that ran up to them.

paragraphs.tr: Köpeğin sahiplenilmeyi beklediğini öğrenince hemen karar verdiler.
paragraphs.en: When they learned the dog had been waiting to be adopted, they decided right away.

paragraphs.tr: Eve geldikten sonra köpeğe Boncuk adını verdiler.
paragraphs.en: After bringing him home, they named the dog Boncuk.

paragraphs.tr: Kısa sürede Boncuk ailenin vazgeçilmez bir üyesi oldu.
paragraphs.en: In a short time, Boncuk became an indispensable member of the family.

questions.question: What had the family been discussing?
Where did they go?
How did the dog approach them?
What did they name the dog?

lessons.title: A Broken Promise
lessons.context: A short story about disappointment and forgiveness between friends.

paragraphs.tr: Ozan arkadaşı Ege'ye maçtan sonra buluşacaklarına söz vermişti.
paragraphs.en: Ozan had promised his friend Ege that they would meet after the match.

paragraphs.tr: Ancak son anda işi çıkınca sözünü tutamadı.
paragraphs.en: However, when something came up at the last minute, he couldn't keep his promise.

paragraphs.tr: Ege bu durumdan biraz kırıldı ama sebebini anlayınca sakinleşti.
paragraphs.en: Ege was a little hurt by this, but calmed down once he understood the reason.

paragraphs.tr: Ozan ertesi gün özür diledi ve onu telafi etmek için yemeğe davet etti.
paragraphs.en: The next day, Ozan apologized and invited him to dinner to make it up to him.

paragraphs.tr: İki arkadaş bu küçük anlaşmazlığı konuşarak çözdü.
paragraphs.en: The two friends resolved this small disagreement by talking it through.

paragraphs.tr: Bu olay onlara iletişimin önemini bir kez daha hatırlattı.
paragraphs.en: This incident reminded them once again of the importance of communication.

questions.question: What had Ozan promised?
Why couldn't he keep his promise?
options: Something came up at the last minute

questions.question: How did Ege feel at first?
What did Ozan do to make it up to him?

lessons.title: Studying Abroad
lessons.context: A short story about a student's exchange semester in another country.

paragraphs.tr: Beste üniversite eğitiminin bir dönemini yurt dışında geçirmeye karar verdi.
paragraphs.en: Beste decided to spend one semester of her university education abroad.

paragraphs.tr: Almanya'daki bir üniversiteyle değişim programı için anlaştı.
paragraphs.en: She arranged an exchange program with a university in Germany.

paragraphs.tr: İlk haftalarda yeni bir dile ve kültüre alışmakta zorlandı.
paragraphs.en: In the first weeks, she had difficulty adjusting to a new language and culture.

paragraphs.tr: Zamanla yeni arkadaşlar edindi ve kendini daha rahat hissetmeye başladı.
paragraphs.en: Over time, she made new friends and started to feel more comfortable.

paragraphs.tr: Bu deneyim ona hem akademik hem de kişisel olarak çok şey kattı.
paragraphs.en: This experience contributed a lot to her both academically and personally.

paragraphs.tr: Beste, bu fırsatı değerlendirdiği için hiç pişman olmadı.
paragraphs.en: Beste never regretted taking advantage of this opportunity.

questions.question: Where did Beste go for her exchange program?
What was difficult in the first weeks?
options: Adjusting to a new language and culture

questions.question: What helped her feel more comfortable over time?
How does Beste feel about this experience now?

lessons.title: A Surprise Promotion
lessons.context: A short story about an employee's unexpected career advancement.

paragraphs.tr: Ozan işe başladığından beri hep sıkı çalışan bir çalışan olarak bilinirdi.
paragraphs.en: Ozan had been known as a hardworking employee since he started the job.

paragraphs.tr: Bir sabah yöneticisi onu ofisine çağırdı.
paragraphs.en: One morning, his manager called him into the office.

paragraphs.tr: Ozan önce bir sorun olduğunu düşünerek endişelendi.
paragraphs.en: At first, Ozan worried, thinking there was a problem.

paragraphs.tr: Ancak yöneticisi ona terfi ettiğini müjdeledi.
paragraphs.en: But his manager gave him the good news that he had been promoted.

paragraphs.tr: Ozan bu habere hem şaşırdı hem de çok sevindi.
paragraphs.en: Ozan was both surprised and very happy at this news.

paragraphs.tr: Akşam ailesine haberi verirken gözyaşlarını tutamadı.
paragraphs.en: In the evening, he couldn't hold back his tears while telling his family the news.

questions.question: How was Ozan known at work?
Why did Ozan worry at first?
options: He thought he was being fired
He thought there was a problem

questions.question: What news did his manager give him?
How did Ozan react?

lessons.title: A Community Garden
lessons.context: A short story about neighbors creating a shared garden space.

paragraphs.tr: Sokaktaki boş bir arsa uzun süredir kullanılmadan duruyordu.
paragraphs.en: An empty lot on the street had been unused for a long time.

paragraphs.tr: Komşulardan biri burayı bir topluluk bahçesine dönüştürme fikrini ortaya attı.
paragraphs.en: One of the neighbors came up with the idea of turning it into a community garden.

paragraphs.tr: Herkes hafta sonları gelip toprağı hazırlamaya ve tohum ekmeye başladı.
paragraphs.en: Everyone started coming on weekends to prepare the soil and plant seeds.

paragraphs.tr: Birkaç ay içinde arsa rengarenk sebze ve çiçeklerle doldu.
paragraphs.en: Within a few months, the lot was filled with colorful vegetables and flowers.

paragraphs.tr: Bahçe, komşuların bir araya gelmesi için de güzel bir fırsat yarattı.
paragraphs.en: The garden also created a wonderful opportunity for neighbors to come together.

paragraphs.tr: Şimdi herkes hasat zamanı sebzeleri paylaşarak keyifli vakit geçiriyor.
paragraphs.en: Now everyone enjoys sharing the vegetables at harvest time.

questions.question: What had the empty lot been for a long time?
What idea did a neighbor propose?
options: Turning it into a community garden

questions.question: What did everyone start doing on weekends?
options: Preparing the soil and planting seeds

questions.question: What does the garden create an opportunity for?

lessons.title: A Difficult Exam
lessons.context: A short story about a student overcoming exam anxiety.

paragraphs.tr: Sınav haftası yaklaştıkça Buse'nin kaygısı da artıyordu.
paragraphs.en: As exam week approached, Buse's anxiety was increasing.

paragraphs.tr: Özellikle matematik sınavından çok korkuyordu.
paragraphs.en: She was especially afraid of the math exam.

paragraphs.tr: Öğretmeni ona düzenli çalışmanın panikten daha etkili olduğunu söyledi.
paragraphs.en: Her teacher told her that studying regularly was more effective than panicking.

paragraphs.tr: Buse bu tavsiyeyi dinleyip her gün küçük parçalar halinde çalıştı.
paragraphs.en: Buse listened to this advice and studied in small pieces every day.

paragraphs.tr: Sınav günü geldiğinde kendini daha hazır ve sakin hissetti.
paragraphs.en: When exam day arrived, she felt more prepared and calm.

paragraphs.tr: Sonuçlar geldiğinde beklediğinden çok daha iyi bir not aldığını gördü.
paragraphs.en: When the results came, she saw that she had gotten a much better grade than she expected.

questions.question: What was increasing as exam week approached?
Which exam was she especially afraid of?
What did her teacher advise?
options: Studying regularly is more effective than panicking

questions.question: How did Buse feel on exam day?

lessons.title: A New Hobby
lessons.context: A short story about discovering a passion for painting.

paragraphs.tr: Cemre iş stresinden uzaklaşmak için yeni bir hobi aramaya başladı.
paragraphs.en: Cemre started looking for a new hobby to get away from work stress.

paragraphs.tr: Bir arkadaşının önerisiyle bir resim kursuna yazıldı.
paragraphs.en: On a friend's suggestion, she enrolled in a painting course.

paragraphs.tr: İlk denemeleri pek başarılı olmasa da vazgeçmedi.
paragraphs.en: Although her first attempts weren't very successful, she didn't give up.

paragraphs.tr: Her hafta biraz daha gelişerek kendine olan güvenini artırdı.
paragraphs.en: Each week, she improved a little more and gained more confidence.

paragraphs.tr: Birkaç ay sonra kendi tablolarından birini evine astı.
paragraphs.en: A few months later, she hung one of her own paintings at home.

paragraphs.tr: Cemre artık resim yapmanın en sevdiği rahatlama yöntemi olduğunu söylüyor.
paragraphs.en: Cemre now says that painting is her favorite way to relax.

questions.question: Why did Cemre look for a new hobby?
options: To get away from work stress

questions.question: What did she enroll in?
How were her first attempts?
What does Cemre say now?
options: Painting is her favorite way to relax

lessons.title: A Family Reunion
lessons.context: A short story about relatives gathering after years apart.

paragraphs.tr: Bu yaz aile, yıllardır bir araya gelmedikleri büyük bir buluşma düzenledi.
paragraphs.en: This summer, the family organized a big reunion after not gathering for years.

paragraphs.tr: Farklı şehirlerden ve hatta farklı ülkelerden akrabalar katıldı.
paragraphs.en: Relatives came from different cities and even different countries.

paragraphs.tr: Herkes eski fotoğrafları çıkarıp anılarını paylaştı.
paragraphs.en: Everyone brought out old photos and shared their memories.

paragraphs.tr: Çocuklar ilk kez birbirleriyle tanıştı ve hemen arkadaş oldu.
paragraphs.en: The children met each other for the first time and quickly became friends.

paragraphs.tr: Buluşma üç gün sürdü ve herkes çok duygulandı.
paragraphs.en: The reunion lasted three days, and everyone was very moved.

paragraphs.tr: Ayrılırken hepsi bu geleneği her yıl tekrarlamaya karar verdi.
paragraphs.en: As they parted, they all decided to repeat this tradition every year.

questions.question: What did the family organize this summer?
Where did relatives come from?
What did the children do?
options: Met for the first time and became friends

questions.question: What did they decide as they parted?
options: To repeat this tradition every year

lessons.title: Quitting Sugar
lessons.context: A short story about a personal health challenge.

paragraphs.tr: Aylin bir ay boyunca şekerli yiyeceklerden uzak durmaya karar verdi.
paragraphs.en: Aylin decided to stay away from sugary foods for a month.

paragraphs.tr: İlk günler oldukça zorlandı, özellikle tatlı krizleri yaşadı.
paragraphs.en: The first few days were quite difficult, especially with sugar cravings.

paragraphs.tr: Bunun yerine meyve yemeye ve bol su içmeye başladı.
paragraphs.en: Instead, she started eating fruit and drinking plenty of water.

paragraphs.tr: İkinci haftadan sonra kendini çok daha enerjik hissetmeye başladı.
paragraphs.en: After the second week, she began to feel much more energetic.

paragraphs.tr: Uyku düzeni de eskisinden daha iyi hale geldi.
paragraphs.en: Her sleep pattern also became better than before.

paragraphs.tr: Ay sonunda Aylin bu değişikliği kalıcı hale getirmeye karar verdi.
paragraphs.en: By the end of the month, Aylin decided to make this change permanent.

questions.question: What did Aylin decide to avoid for a month?
What did she struggle with in the first days?
What did she eat instead?
options: Fruit, and drank plenty of water

questions.question: What did she decide at the end of the month?
options: To go back to old habits

lessons.title: A Delayed Flight
lessons.context: A short story about coping with an unexpected travel delay.

paragraphs.tr: Havaalanına vardığında Umut uçağının iki saat rötarlı olduğunu öğrendi.
paragraphs.en: When Umut arrived at the airport, he learned his flight was delayed by two hours.

paragraphs.tr: İlk başta çok sinirlendi çünkü önemli bir toplantıya yetişmesi gerekiyordu.
paragraphs.en: At first, he was very annoyed because he needed to make an important meeting.

paragraphs.tr: Ancak yapabileceği bir şey olmadığını anlayınca sakinleşmeye çalıştı.
paragraphs.en: But once he realized there was nothing he could do, he tried to calm down.

paragraphs.tr: Bekleme salonunda bir kitap okuyarak ve kahve içerek zaman geçirdi.
paragraphs.en: He spent his time reading a book and drinking coffee in the waiting area.

paragraphs.tr: Toplantı organizatörünü arayıp durumu açıkladı ve anlayışla karşılandı.
paragraphs.en: He called the meeting organizer, explained the situation, and was met with understanding.

paragraphs.tr: Sonunda uçuş gecikmesine rağmen gün iyi geçti.
paragraphs.en: In the end, despite the flight delay, the day went well.

questions.question: How long was Umut's flight delayed?
Why was he initially annoyed?
options: He needed to make an important meeting

questions.question: What did he do in the waiting area?
options: Read a book and drank coffee

questions.question: How did the meeting organizer react?

lessons.title: Learning to Say No
lessons.context: A short story about setting healthy boundaries.

paragraphs.tr: Merve her zaman herkese yardım etmeye çalışan biriydi.
paragraphs.en: Merve had always been someone who tried to help everyone.

paragraphs.tr: Ancak zamanla bu durumun kendi işlerini aksattığını fark etti.
paragraphs.en: Over time, though, she realized this situation was disrupting her own work.

paragraphs.tr: Bir gün bir arkadaşının isteğine ilk kez hayır demeye karar verdi.
paragraphs.en: One day, she decided to say no to a friend's request for the first time.

paragraphs.tr: Başta suçluluk hissetse de zamanla bunun normal olduğunu anladı.
paragraphs.en: Although she felt guilty at first, she eventually understood that this was normal.

paragraphs.tr: Sınırlar koymanın aslında ilişkilerini daha sağlıklı hale getirdiğini fark etti.
paragraphs.en: She realized that setting boundaries actually made her relationships healthier.

paragraphs.tr: Merve artık kendi zamanına daha çok değer veriyor.
paragraphs.en: Merve now values her own time much more.

questions.question: What kind of person was Merve?
options: Someone who tried to help everyone

questions.question: What did she realize over time?
options: She had too much free time
This behavior was disrupting her own work

questions.question: How did she feel after saying no for the first time?
What did she realize about setting boundaries?

lessons.title: A Weekend Market
lessons.context: A short story about the atmosphere of a lively local market.

paragraphs.tr: Her cumartesi sabahı meydanda canlı bir pazar kurulur.
paragraphs.en: Every Saturday morning, a lively market is set up in the square.

paragraphs.tr: Çiftçiler taze sebze ve meyvelerini tezgahlara diziyor.
paragraphs.en: Farmers arrange their fresh vegetables and fruits on the stalls.

paragraphs.tr: Zanaatkarlar da el yapımı ürünlerini satmak için orada oluyor.
paragraphs.en: Craftspeople are also there to sell their handmade products.

paragraphs.tr: İnsanlar hem alışveriş yapıyor hem de komşularıyla sohbet ediyor.
paragraphs.en: People both shop and chat with their neighbors.

paragraphs.tr: Havanın güzel olduğu günlerde pazar oldukça kalabalık oluyor.
paragraphs.en: On days when the weather is nice, the market gets quite crowded.

paragraphs.tr: Bu pazar, mahallenin en canlı buluşma noktalarından biri haline geldi.
paragraphs.en: This market has become one of the liveliest meeting points in the neighborhood.

questions.question: When is the market set up?
What do farmers sell?
Who else is there besides farmers?
What has this market become?
options: One of the liveliest meeting points

lessons.title: A Second Chance
lessons.context: A short story about redemption after a mistake at work.

paragraphs.tr: Bir hata yaptıktan sonra Kaan işini kaybedeceğini düşündü.
paragraphs.en: After making a mistake, Kaan thought he would lose his job.

paragraphs.tr: Ancak yöneticisi onu ofisine çağırıp durumu sakince konuştu.
paragraphs.en: However, his manager called him into the office and discussed the situation calmly.

paragraphs.tr: Yöneticisi herkesin hata yapabileceğini ve önemli olanın ondan ders çıkarmak olduğunu söyledi.
paragraphs.en: The manager said everyone can make mistakes and what matters is learning from them.

paragraphs.tr: Kaan bu ikinci şansı ciddiye aldı ve hatasını düzeltmek için elinden geleni yaptı.
paragraphs.en: Kaan took this second chance seriously and did everything he could to fix his mistake.

paragraphs.tr: Birkaç ay içinde güvenini yeniden kazandı ve daha dikkatli çalışmaya başladı.
paragraphs.en: Within a few months, he regained his confidence and started working more carefully.

paragraphs.tr: Bu deneyim Kaan'a hem alçakgönüllülüğü hem de sorumluluğu öğretti.
paragraphs.en: This experience taught Kaan both humility and responsibility.

questions.question: What did Kaan think would happen after his mistake?
What did the manager say?
options: Everyone can make mistakes; what matters is learning

questions.question: What did Kaan do with his second chance?
options: Took it seriously and worked to fix his mistake

questions.question: What did this experience teach Kaan?

lessons.title: A Homemade Meal
lessons.context: A short story about cooking a meal to comfort a friend.

paragraphs.tr: Zeynep arkadaşı Elif'in zor bir hafta geçirdiğini öğrendi.
paragraphs.en: Zeynep learned that her friend Elif had had a difficult week.

paragraphs.tr: Onu neşelendirmek için ev yapımı bir yemek hazırlamaya karar verdi.
paragraphs.en: She decided to prepare a homemade meal to cheer her up.

paragraphs.tr: Marketten malzemeleri aldı ve Elif'in en sevdiği yemeği pişirdi.
paragraphs.en: She bought ingredients from the market and cooked Elif's favorite dish.

paragraphs.tr: Akşam yemeği Elif'in kapısına gittiğinde onu büyük bir şaşkınlıkla karşıladı.
paragraphs.en: When Zeynep went to Elif's door with dinner, Elif greeted her with great surprise.

paragraphs.tr: Birlikte yemek yiyip uzun uzun sohbet ettiler.
paragraphs.en: They ate together and talked for a long time.

paragraphs.tr: Elif bu küçük jestin onu çok mutlu ettiğini söyledi.
paragraphs.en: Elif said this small gesture made her very happy.

questions.question: What did Zeynep learn about Elif?
What did Zeynep decide to do?
What did she cook?
How did Elif feel about the gesture?

lessons.title: An Old Photograph
lessons.context: A short story about discovering a meaningful old photo.

paragraphs.tr: Evi düzenlerken Ferhat eski bir kutuda unutulmuş bir fotoğraf albümü buldu.
paragraphs.en: While tidying the house, Ferhat found a forgotten photo album in an old box.

paragraphs.tr: Albümdeki fotoğraflar büyükbabasının gençlik yıllarına aitti.
paragraphs.en: The photos in the album were from his grandfather's youth.

paragraphs.tr: Bir fotoğrafta büyükbabası hiç bilmediği bir şehirde gülümsüyordu.
paragraphs.en: In one photo, his grandfather was smiling in a city Ferhat had never known about.

paragraphs.tr: Merak ederek büyükbabasına fotoğrafı gösterdi ve hikayesini sordu.
paragraphs.en: Curious, he showed the photo to his grandfather and asked about its story.

paragraphs.tr: Büyükbabası gençliğinde orada nasıl çalıştığını uzun uzun anlattı.
paragraphs.en: His grandfather told him at length about how he had worked there in his youth.

paragraphs.tr: Ferhat bu sohbetin ailesinin tarihini daha yakından tanımasını sağladığını düşündü.
paragraphs.en: Ferhat thought this conversation allowed him to get to know his family's history more closely.

questions.question: What did Ferhat find while tidying the house?
Whose youth did the photos show?
What did Ferhat do with the photo?
options: Showed it to his grandfather and asked about it

questions.question: What did Ferhat think about the conversation?
options: It was a waste of time
It helped him know his family's history better

lessons.title: A Neighborhood Cafe
lessons.context: A short story about a small cafe that became a community hub.

paragraphs.tr: Beş yıl önce mahalleye küçük bir kafe açıldı.
paragraphs.en: Five years ago, a small cafe opened in the neighborhood.

paragraphs.tr: Başlangıçta çok az müşterisi vardı.
paragraphs.en: In the beginning, it had very few customers.

paragraphs.tr: Sahibi kaliteli kahve ve sıcak bir ortam sunmaya özen gösterdi.
paragraphs.en: The owner took care to offer quality coffee and a warm atmosphere.

paragraphs.tr: Zamanla mahalle sakinleri burayı buluşma noktası olarak kullanmaya başladı.
paragraphs.en: Over time, neighborhood residents started using it as a meeting point.

paragraphs.tr: Şimdi kafe her sabah kalabalık ve hareketli.
paragraphs.en: Now the cafe is crowded and lively every morning.

paragraphs.tr: Sahibi bu başarının sabır ve samimiyetten geldiğine inanıyor.
paragraphs.en: The owner believes this success comes from patience and sincerity.

questions.question: When did the cafe open?
How was business in the beginning?
What did the owner focus on offering?
options: Quality coffee and a warm atmosphere

questions.question: What does the owner believe led to success?

lessons.title: A Language Exchange
lessons.context: A short story about two strangers becoming friends through language practice.

paragraphs.tr: Bora İngilizcesini geliştirmek için bir dil değişim uygulaması kullanmaya başladı.
paragraphs.en: Bora started using a language exchange app to improve his English.

paragraphs.tr: Uygulamada Türkçe öğrenmek isteyen Amerikalı bir kadınla eşleşti.
paragraphs.en: On the app, he was matched with an American woman who wanted to learn Turkish.

paragraphs.tr: Her hafta video görüşmesi yaparak birbirlerine dillerini öğrettiler.
paragraphs.en: Every week, they had video calls to teach each other their languages.

paragraphs.tr: Zamanla sadece dil pratiği değil, gerçek bir arkadaşlık da kurdular.
paragraphs.en: Over time, they built not just language practice, but also a real friendship.

paragraphs.tr: Bir yıl sonra Bora, arkadaşını ziyaret etmek için Amerika'ya gitti.
paragraphs.en: A year later, Bora went to America to visit his friend.

paragraphs.tr: İkisi de bu deneyimin hayatlarını zenginleştirdiğini söylüyor.
paragraphs.en: Both of them say this experience enriched their lives.

questions.question: Why did Bora start using the app?
Who was he matched with?
options: A stranger with no interest in languages

questions.question: What did they build over time, besides language skills?
What did Bora do a year later?
options: Went to America to visit her

lessons.title: A Charity Run
lessons.context: A short story about training for and completing a charity race.

paragraphs.tr: Gamze bir hastane için para toplamak amacıyla düzenlenen bir koşuya katılmaya karar verdi.
paragraphs.en: Gamze decided to participate in a run organized to raise money for a hospital.

paragraphs.tr: Daha önce hiç uzun mesafe koşmamıştı, bu yüzden aylarca antrenman yaptı.
paragraphs.en: She had never run a long distance before, so she trained for months.

paragraphs.tr: Ailesi ve arkadaşları onu bağışlarla destekledi.
paragraphs.en: Her family and friends supported her with donations.

paragraphs.tr: Koşu günü hava çok sıcaktı ama Gamze pes etmedi.
paragraphs.en: On race day, the weather was very hot, but Gamze didn't give up.

paragraphs.tr: Bitiş çizgisini geçtiğinde büyük bir gurur duydu.
paragraphs.en: When she crossed the finish line, she felt great pride.

paragraphs.tr: Topladığı bağışlar hastanenin yeni bir bölüm açmasına yardımcı oldu.
paragraphs.en: The donations she raised helped the hospital open a new department.

questions.question: Why was the run organized?
options: To raise money for a hospital

questions.question: Had Gamze run long distances before?
Who supported her with donations?
What did the donations help with?

lessons.title: A Career Fair
lessons.context: A short story about a student exploring job opportunities.

paragraphs.tr: Üniversitenin son sınıfında olan Tuna bir kariyer fuarına katıldı.
paragraphs.en: In his final year of university, Tuna attended a career fair.

paragraphs.tr: Fuarda birçok farklı şirketin standını ziyaret etti.
paragraphs.en: At the fair, he visited many different companies' booths.

paragraphs.tr: Bazı temsilcilerle kısa görüşmeler yaparak kendini tanıttı.
paragraphs.en: He introduced himself in short conversations with some representatives.

paragraphs.tr: Bir teknoloji şirketinin temsilcisiyle yaptığı sohbet özellikle dikkatini çekti.
paragraphs.en: His conversation with a representative from a tech company especially caught his interest.

paragraphs.tr: Fuardan sonra o şirkete başvuru yaptı ve bir görüşmeye çağrıldı.
paragraphs.en: After the fair, he applied to that company and was invited to an interview.

paragraphs.tr: Tuna bu fuarın kariyerinde önemli bir dönüm noktası olduğunu düşünüyor.
paragraphs.en: Tuna thinks this fair was an important turning point in his career.

questions.question: What did Tuna attend?
What did he do at the fair?

lessons.title: A Rainy Camping Trip
lessons.context: A short story about making the best of unexpected weather on a camping trip.

paragraphs.tr: Arkadaş grubu bir hafta sonu kamp yapmayı planlamıştı.
paragraphs.en: A group of friends had planned to go camping for a weekend.

paragraphs.tr: Ancak vardıklarında hava tahminlerinin aksine yağmur başladı.
paragraphs.en: However, when they arrived, it started raining, contrary to the weather forecast.

paragraphs.tr: İlk başta hayal kırıklığına uğradılar ama vazgeçmemeye karar verdiler.
paragraphs.en: At first, they were disappointed, but they decided not to give up.

paragraphs.tr: Çadırlarını sağlamlaştırıp bir tarp ile yağmurdan korundular.
paragraphs.en: They reinforced their tents and protected themselves from the rain with a tarp.

paragraphs.tr: Yağmurun altında kart oynayıp şarkı söyleyerek eğlendiler.
paragraphs.en: They had fun playing cards and singing under the rain.

paragraphs.tr: Bu beklenmedik kamp, grubun en unutulmaz anılarından biri oldu.
paragraphs.en: This unexpected camping trip became one of the group's most unforgettable memories.
